reviews.title: Great small motherboard for 10th gen Intel
reviews.comment: I love Asrock motherboards and have ordered countless one over the years. This board did not disappoint. I installed all the parts and it fired up and was ready to install Windows. I did find that paired with an i3 10105F it would only run the ram at 2666Mhz but it ran great with a GTX 980. I believe the i5 and i7 cpus support the full 2933Mhz this board advertises. I do recommend looking at reviews before buying any pc parts. Motherboards should have close to an 80% under the 5 star rating.
reviews.author: Evan

reviews.title: Basic LGA 1200 Motherboard that is easy to work with
reviews.comment: I'll update if I have any problems, but after a few days of use, I love this board.  It's a very basic motherboard with limited I/O but it was a drop-in replacement for my HTPC that was previously using an older embedded AMD board with a discrete Geforce 1030.  I already had a Celeron G5905 lying around so I pulled the trigger on this board and it hasn't disappointed.  There's no NVME slot.  The x16 slot is below the x1 slot so if you're using a discrete graphics card like I am, the x1 slot isn't blocked by the heatsink.  It arrived with the most recent BIOS revision.  Only 4 SATA ports, but that's one more than I needed so all good there.  For $60 USD it's hard to do better.
reviews.author: Matt Boswell
